dct_description_sm:
Identifies the (point) locations of features such as stakes, pins, signs etc., used to mark and/or locate a research plot on the ground. The features in this layer should be associated with a feature from Research Point (RESPOINT), Research Line (RESLINE) or Research Polygon (RESPOLY) data class layers.
